strings.en: ...That's how things stand. Do you understand?
...I understand.
Then we'll take your grandchildren into our care.
Take care of them. Kappei, Uchuta, Keiko, mind Commander Hazuki
and work together, you hear?
Leave it to me, Gramps!
We'll kick Gaizok's butt, and Zeon's and the Mechanical Beasts' too!
Heh, just don't go spinning your wheels.
Cut it out, Uchuta!
...Any way you look at it... they're just normal kids.
Well, yeah. Being told out of nowhere that your ancestors were aliens...
is kinda hard to take in.
Maybe the old man has the wrong idea of what "Spacenoid" means?
But he said they came from a star system 47 light-years away,
hundreds of years ago, didn't he?
Well, the Muge Empire came from outer space too.
And with countless mysterious armies running loose on Earth these days,
it's no surprise if some aliens got in.
Yeah, yeah. If we get along, what's the difference?
Aliens, huh... I wonder how he's doing, Tetsuya.
He...? Oh, Daisuke. I hear he's with Londo Bell now...
Huh, there are other aliens besides us?
Is this Daisuke one of them?
Sounds like a Japanese name.
His real name's Duke Fleed, though.
He's the pilot of Grendizer, who came to Earth from planet Fleed.
To me and Tetsuya, he's like a big brother.
Come to think of it, Daisuke was goin' on about some invasion from Vega.
What happened with that?
Yeah, now that you mention it. Was it those clay-doll-lookin' things?
But didn't they call those Gaizok?
What concerns me are the bug mechs. Kappei, were those Gaizok too?
Hmm, never seen that type before... but I bet they're Gaizok.
Gaizok and the Vega Star Federation... We didn't run into Vega.
Maybe Londo Bell is keeping them in check.
Daisuke's with them, so that's probably it.
Daisuke... I hope he's not having a hard time.
Heh, no need to worry about space. We're the ones going!
...I just hope that doesn't become a problem in itself.
Heh, no doubt. Space aside, we've got a mountain of problems on the ground.
In the end, we spent the whole time fighting Zeon ground forces,
the Mechanical Beast army, and... Gaizok, was it?
And the Nadesico, that mobile battleship...
In the middle of this war, it seemed to act on its own, outside the military.
Their captain was pretty cute, huh?
Whoa, that's your type? ...I'd go for someone more homey...
You're missing the point.
...We've lost track of them since then. What's going on?
Hmm, there's the Dinosaur Empire survivors too...
None of our problems are solved.
And if an alien invasion piles on top of that...
And Dr. Hell, too. ...What's happening to Earth, seriously?
Hm? Lieutenant Amada...?
Oh, no, it's nothing. ...What worries me most is what Zeon is up to.
I see... That's fine, then.
(...That custom Gouf that attacked the Cyber Beast Force base...
Was that... hers...?)
Guesswork won't get us anywhere.
Hey, Commander. Can't you confirm what's going on?
I'm working on it. Yuiry, have you found anything?
...Minovsky particle density... seems to have thinned considerably.
We're clear. Opening the channel!
Ho ho ho ho! How utterly unpleasant!
In space, someone got in my way when I was so close,
and down here, those brats' robots made a fool of me... Infuriating!
...tcher...
And what were those bug-like robots?
If they'd only shaped up, it would've been so much easier.
Mecha Boosts are the best after all, ho ho ho...
...Butcher...
...Butcher, forget not thy contract...
Eeeyaaah! Th-This is... N-N-No, it can't be...
...What is this, Butcher...? My command was... destruction...
I-I-I-I know, sir! There was interference, yes. Interference, and...
...One who defies my command... bears no light sin...
F-Forgive me! At once! I'll see to it at once!
...Because we in Londo Bell couldn't hold them back...
we let Gaizok descend to Earth. I'm sorry...
No, it couldn't be helped in this situation, Captain Bright.
The Elshank, the ship that attacked the Mars Frontier Base,
is also heading for the surface.
The base was attacked? What is this Elshank...?
Commander Hazard of the Mars Frontier Base said it was a scout
for new invaders, the Za Boom Army, but...
But...?
It never attacked us,
and it looked like it was being chased by the Za Boom Army.
Also, the base commander, Hazard Pasha...
seems to be hiding something.
I see... the Za Boom Army. We'll stay on guard here too.
Still, it's worrying. Mars...
Even though the Jovian Lizards have appeared on Mars,
Commander Hazard said there was no need to worry about Mars...
I see... Mars's forces can hardly be called sufficient, though...
Perhaps they're lucky that the unmanned Jovian Lizards
aren't all that powerful.
Or... is there some reason it'd be bad for us to come to Mars...
Yes. Either way, it needs investigating.
By the way, how are things on the surface?
Those Jovian Lizards, in fact, appeared in Sasebo.
Sasebo!? Isn't that where...
Yes, where the Nadesico's hangar was.
The Nadesico... Nergal's mobile battleship, built in secret...
When we reached Sasebo, the Jovian Lizards were fighting the Nadesico.
It's hard to believe the Jovian Lizards showed up in Sasebo by chance.
Yes... They were most likely after the Nadesico...
Though it does bother me that a Gaizok battleship appeared
after our Gandor Team arrived in Sasebo...
Are you saying the Jovian Lizards were Gaizok machines?
...The Jin family said they probably were...
but it's only a possibility. We can't be certain.
I feel the Jovian Lizards belong to some other organization entirely.
True, it's dangerous to simply link Gaizok and the Jovian Lizards.
Yes...
Where is the Nadesico now?
The Nadesico got away from us in Sasebo.
I see... But I can guess where it's headed.
Yes... Most likely to Mars.
So it's begun? ...The Scaparelli Project...
And about the Nadesico's captain...
Hm? A transmission...
So in the end, we don't know a thing about these Jovian Lizards.
Just "mysterious unmanned weapons of unknown origin."
There's way too little information.
What about the possibility it's a new Zeon weapon?
That's no Zeonic design, any way you look at it, Lieutenant.
How can you tell?
...Long story. From way back.
Who cares if it's Zeon or not?
The name's a joke, anyway.
Right? It says "Jovian," but does that mean anything...?
...When they first appeared on Mars,
I hear they came endlessly from the direction of Jupiter.
So they're like a lizard's tail that keeps growing back?
So that's why they're Jovian Lizards? Kinda simple, huh?
You know a lot, Nanbu.
I checked the database here. I only just learned it myself.
Do they have something to do with Gaizok?
Who knows.
If the Jovian Lizards are alien weapons, it's not out of the question.
So all we know is the name.
And we don't know their connection to that battleship, the Nadesico.
One mystery leads to another, huh? Gimme a break.
...over. This is Admiral Koichiro Misumaru of the Federation 3rd Fleet.
Please respond.
A-Admiral Misumaru!?
Ohh! Finally got through...
Well, I'm glad you're safe, Commander Hazuki of the Far East Branch.
Where are you now, Admiral?
We're currently dealing with the enemy in the European theater.
Europe? Weren't you supposed to be at Jaburo?
Ah, I was indeed at Jaburo,
but an urgent mission brought me here.
I see...
Then you don't know why Jaburo went silent either, Admiral?
No. I sent a recon unit, but haven't heard back...
So... some organization really has taken Jaburo?
Indeed. That's why I want the Gandor Team to go to Jaburo.
...We were thinking of heading to Jaburo ourselves... However...
with invaders appearing one after another, it's difficult right now.
I'm well aware!
Not right away, perhaps, but only the Gandor Team, our strongest unit,
could possibly reach Jaburo!
Admiral... So Jaburo really has...
Yes. Not something I like to think about, but...
Understood. We'll investigate Jaburo.
Good. I'm counting on you.
By the way, Admiral, are you aware that the Nadesico...
Nergal's mobile battleship, has left Sasebo?
Yuuurikaaa! Why, oh why did you leave your daddy behind!?
Captain Bright... the Nadesico's captain is the Admiral's daughter.
The Admiral's...!? I-I see... So she's the Nadesico's captain...
That's right! Yurikaaa, please come home!
A-Admiral...
Hm!? ...Ahem! ...When it comes to my daughter, I lose my composure.
My apologies. Harrumph.
N-No, that's just how fathers are...
Isn't it, though!? Bright, my boy, you must cherish your wife and kids...
Um... May we get back on topic? ...Admiral?
Oh, right you are.
As you all know, the Scaparelli Project is underway.
And my beloved Yurika is aboard the Nadesico as its captain.
Nergal's manager said it was all settled with the Federation, but...
...To tell the truth, I don't know the details either.
It seems the heads of the Federation and Nergal
worked it out between themselves while I was away.
I see...
But what kind of deal with Nergal can't be shared with an admiral...?
Indeed. And with Jaburo as it is, there's no way to confirm it.
...But it's clear the Nadesico is no enemy.
Meaning...?
Why, Yurika is its captain, after all! Wa ha ha ha ha!
Ugh... Y-Yes, your daughter can be trusted... The problem is Nergal.
I can't believe the Scaparelli Project's goal
stops at simply retaking Mars.
Hmm. That concerns me as well...
But for now, the Nadesico is a valuable asset, military or not.
Yes, that's true.
What is your view, Admiral Misumaru?
Should we really let the Nadesico go on to Mars like this?
Mars's forces are especially thin.
If the Nadesico goes there, it'll surely help Commander Hazard...
Admiral. About this Commander Hazard...
Hazard Pasha, the commander of the Mars Frontier Base...
Hmm. I see... That is suspicious...
But if the Nadesico heads to Mars, something is bound to happen.
Please pass that along to Yurika as well.
Understood, Admiral.
Then I wish you all the best of luck.
So we still don't know what's going on at Jaburo...
Still, it's a relief to hear that Admiral Misumaru and other Federation
forces are dealing with enemies around the world.
Yes. If we can track down the Nadesico, we'll try to make contact.
Please do. ...We'll arrive at the Space Science Laboratory shortly.
I'll send either Kabuto or Tsurugi to you.
When things are so bad on the surface too...
I don't know what to say, making you split your forces like this...
No, we'll manage here.
In any case, with that many organizations on the move,
the more strength the better...
We can't rely on a helper who may or may not show up... Please.
Still, how intriguing. A hero standing atop your bridge, you say?
I almost wish we had one here, too.
Nothing makes any sense. ...It's enough to drive me mad.
Tetsuya Tsurugi and Koji Kabuto, reporting.
Commander Hazuki, what did you want to talk about?
Yes. I'm sorry this is so sudden...
but I need one of you two to go to space.
Huh?
What do you mean, Commander?
I just spoke with Captain Bright of Londo Bell.
It seems they're having a very hard fight.
And we still can't reach Jaburo, Federation HQ.
So basically, you want us to go back them up.
And there's the Nadesico to think of. Are they headed for space?
...Yes. The Federation doesn't have the strength to stop them right now.
...Apparently they broke through.
That whatever-barrier of theirs looked pretty tough, too.
It's a Distortion Field, Koji.
There's also the matter of pursuing the Nadesico. ...From our next stop,
the Space Science Laboratory, we'll launch an HLV carrying Dancougar.
I want one of your teams to go along with them. Understand?
You mean either me and Jun, Great Mazinger and Venus A, or
the Mazinger Z and Dianan A team?
Yes... And I want you to add Boss and the Boss Borot.
Huh? Why Boss? The Borot isn't built for space!
I know. But it's also a valuable unit with a resupply device.
We can resupply at the various labs and bases...
but Londo Bell, alone and without support, can't.
...Got it. I'll tell Boss myself.
So... what'll it be, Tetsuya? You or me?
Send Koji to space / Send Tetsuya to space
We somehow managed to depart Sasebo, didn't we, Captain?
Yes! A~ki~to! It's all thanks to you, Akito!
...I didn't... do anything...
Don't you forget my heroics, now!
Dead battery.
Ugh... That was, uh, me setting up a dramatic crisis!
You were still in a crisis when the Gandor Team had to rescue you.
That Gandor Team...
We kinda dumped everything on them... Was that okay?
They'll be fine. In fact, they're better suited for it than we are.
They're combat experts who fought through the last war, after all.
(Hm...? ...Then why were we chosen...?)
So where should the Nadesico head?
Just as I said before, the Nadesico is heading for Mars!
But Earth has six defense lines, from the 1st to the 6th,
and we'll have to break through them from the inside!
On top of that, invaders like the Vega Star Federation may block our way.
Fortunately, for now, everything from the 2nd to the final defense line
has been neutralized by all the chaos.
The problem is the 1st defense line... the Big Barrier.
There are 24 Barrier Satellites in Earth orbit in total...
Four of them lie on the Nadesico's course.
If we destroy even one, we can break through there.
Er, personally, I'd prefer to get through the barrier peacefully,
without destroying anything, if possible...
If we break a Barrier Satellite... Nergal will have to pay for it...
Can we get past the Big Barrier without destroying a satellite?
Hmm... If we enter the defense line's release code,
it should be fine, but...
Is there a problem?
That release code... I've forgotten which one it was...
Geez, you're hopeless.
Well, isn't that fine?
If we enter the wrong release code,
we can just destroy a satellite and break through!
Either way, we'll get through! Yep!
The Captain is all fired up.
What worries me is that her confidence
doesn't factor in our company's losses at all...
So what's the release code for the defense line?
The defense line release code is... I believe...
Almost at the Space Science Lab, huh.
Space, huh.
If the world were at peace, I'd love to go for a little space walk.
But... with the surface in this state?
Leaving it behind to go to space... doesn't sit right with me.
What're you talking about? ...Space is probably in worse chaos than here.
We'll just do our best down here.
Space... I heard that Nadesico went into space...
Yeah, why'd we just let 'em go? Those guys were... kinda shady.
But they said they'll go to Mars. Isn't that good enough?
Right now, Londo Bell is the only unit in space that's still functioning.
Even if they're civilians, the more firepower the better...
Still, can we really trust 'em that easily?
Seems a little too simple-minded to me.
...If she's really Admiral Misumaru's daughter...
maybe we can trust them?
Flashin' a V sign outta nowhere... I almost flew outta the Borot's mouth!
Hard to say. ...Types like that are tougher than they look.
...And since they don't read the room, they're hard to predict.
Oh? You seem to know a lot.
Yeah. I'd say that captain is quite the character.
And... the man the Commander was talking to, Nergal's manager...
he bothers me too.
The fall of Jaburo, the Federation's stronghold...
and the Nadesico launching because they saw it coming... I'd say so.
What're they plotting... Something's going on where we can't see it.
Agreed. ...But what?
Well, no use worryin'. Leave the surface to the great me and...
Oh, there you are.
Boss, they want you to go to space with the Cyber Beast Force.
Whaaa!?
You're fighting with Londo Bell, along with me.
Whoa, Kabuto, what's this about?
Commander Hazuki told me.
They're splitting the Mazinger team in two, sending half to help Londo Bell.
Good to have you with us, Fujiwara.
Heh heh, I get it, Koji.
They just can't do without the power of me and my Boss Borot!
...Uh, w-well, yeah, something like that, Boss.
Hey, Koji...
Shh, it's fine.
All righty, then! I'm gonna give it my all~!
Koji, we'd better get ready, then.
Right. Space, huh... Heh, I'm getting excited!
You're coming with us to Londo Bell.
Huh? What's that supposed to mean?
Orders from Commander Hazuki.
The Mazinger team splits in two, and half goes to back up Londo Bell.
After talking it over with Koji, Jun and I will go to space. And Boss...
you're coming too.
Heh heh, I get it, Tetsuya.
They just can't do without the power of me and my Boss Borot!
Don't be so carefree.
Great's firepower, Venus's support, the Borot's resupply device...
Everyone has a role. Stay sharp!
What the heck!? The Borot ain't just a lump of resupply gear!
You're so harsh, Tetsuya. You could at least have told him he's right.
Tetsuya's no good at that sort of thing. He's clumsy that way.
...Jun.
Okay, okay, I'm sorry. Come on, let's get ready, Tetsuya, Boss.
